blocks.text: The 2026 Mutya ng Pilipinas pageant season has just started, but one candidate has already picked up an early win, Rica Mae Villasanta who was proclaimed as “Mutya ng Bayan.” The delegate from Camarines Norte garnered 70,230 votes from the official online voting portal, more than 10,000 votes ahead of first runner-up Lyra Punsalan from Davao del Norte, who got 59,630. Close behind with 52,750 votes and closing the podium at third place was Patricia Dueñas from Cebu City, who was proclaimed second runner-up for the Mutya ng Bayan voting. Villasanta received her Mutya ng Bayan title at the press presentation […]... Keep on reading: Mutya ng Pilipinas 2026: Camarines Norte bet tops 'Mutya ng Bayan' poll
